title: Prescribed burn near Rampart Reservoir Thursday
snippet: Conditions have become favorable for conducting broadcast burns across much of Colorado. On Thursday, the U.S. Forest Service is planning a 300-400 acre burn within the Pike-San Isabel National Forest near Rampart Reservoir. Ignitions are anticipated to start at approximately 10 am MDT. Map of broadcast burn units surrounding Rampart Reservoir Smoke will likely be visible today in Woodland Park and along Highway 24 in Green Mountain Falls and Cascade.
